title: 2025 Sage Low Series - Auto #A-ND Nick Degennaro - Richmond University
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2025 Sage Low Series sports trading card featuring an autograph of Nick Degennaro from the Richmond Spiders football team. The card is made of aluminum and card stock, with the autograph in label or sticker format authenticated by Leaf. It is part of the Autographs insert set, marked as a parallel/variety and rookie card. The card is numbered A-ND and is manufactured by SAGE for the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA).
